**What happened, and what you expected**


**Where** (the level, and the add-on or mod if it was one: Death Wish, Cryptic Passage, MARROW, Eviction...)


**The report** (please attach it: it lets us replay exactly what happened)

- In the game: where it goes wrong, open the console with `` ` `` or F1 and type `reportbug <a few words>`. Zip the
  three files it saves in `data\data\bugs\` in your Chosen folder (`<id>.txt`, `<id>.png`, `<id>.rec`) and attach the
  zip here.
- In Chosen Forge: Help > Report a Problem, then zip the folder the status bar names and attach it.

**Version** (the bottom right of the title screen, or `version` in the console; Forge: Help > About)
